ns2:course.label: History of Terrorism
ns2:course.description: Historical examination of strategies of terror, their relationship to conventional warfare, and their political, social, cultural, and religious contexts. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
